title: Public GEO Case Study: Pan-Cancer Meta-Analysis
text: case study benchmarks validates metaXpress pipeline real-world clinical transcriptomics. integrated three independent, publicly available bulk RNA-seq cohorts NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) comparing solid epithelial tumors matched normal tissues: Colorectal Adenocarcinoma (CRC): GSE130688 (n=30n = 30 samples) Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC): GSE136569 (n=10n = 10 samples) Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma (ccRCC): GSE171485 (n=12n = 12 samples) Across 52 patient samples 39,376 aligned genes, metaXpress rescued statistical power small-sample cohorts, identifying 558 robust, shared Pan-Cancer Meta-DEGs (FDR<0.05,|log⁡2FC|≥1.0\text{FDR} < 0.05, |\log_2\text{FC}| \ge 1.0) 100% directional concordance minimal heterogeneity (I2=0.0%^2 = 0.0\%). Canonical cancer drivers identified include MST1R, MUC4, IGF2BP3, CDCP1, alongside conserved tumor suppressors FAM107A.

title: Score a study against the 10-point QC checklist — mx_qc_study
text: 10 criteria : Minimum sample size: least 3 samples per condition     group, required reliable dispersion estimation negative binomial     models (Schurch et al. 2016). Sequencing depth: median library size >= 10 million reads,     ensuring adequate power detecting low-abundance transcripts     (Sims et al. 2014). Alignment rate: mean alignment rate >= 70%, indicating     acceptable read quality (optional; skipped available). rRNA contamination: mean rRNA fraction < 10%, flagging     insufficient ribosomal depletion (optional). Duplicate rate: mean duplicate rate < 50%, flagging     library complexity issues (optional). Gene detection: least 15,000 genes detected >= 50%     samples, confirming adequate transcriptome coverage. Metadata completeness: required columns condition     sample_id present. Clear case/control: exactly two condition levels, ensuring     well-defined contrast differential expression. batch-condition confounding: batch condition     perfectly aliased, make batch correction impossible     (Leek et al. 2010). Raw counts: data non-negative integers maximum     > 1,000, confirming untransformed count data suitable count-based     statistical models.

title: metaXpress 0.99.0
text: Initial Bioconductor submission. Module 1: Data ingestion GEO/SRA local files 10-point QC scoring. Module 2: Normalization (TMM, VST, CPM, TPM, quantile) batch correction (ComBat-seq, ComBat, limma, harmony). Module 3: Per-study differential expression via DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom. Module 4: Meta-analysis statistics — Fisher, Stouffer, inverse-normal, fixed effects, random effects (DerSimonian-Laird), AWmeta. Module 5: Missing gene handling imputation coverage filtering. Module 6: Pathway meta-analysis using KEGG, Reactome, GO, MSigDB Hallmarks. Module 7: Publication-ready visualization (volcano, forest, heatmap, UpSet plots). Module 8: Reproducible HTML/PDF report generation result export.
